business_problem: Kotoko AI needed to migrate a globally oriented AI game from overseas infrastructure, keep latency low for complex multi-agent interactions and reduce the operating cost of cross-region compute and networking.
solution_summary: Kotoko AI and Baidu AI Cloud designed a cross-cloud infrastructure plan for the company's multi-agent companion game, Bside. The game relies on many concurrent AI-driven character interactions, so the technical requirement is not just generic hosting but low-latency, globally distributed delivery for language-model-backed social behavior. Baidu replaced the prior overseas-only deployment pattern with a cross-cloud and cross-product setup that uses BCC cloud servers for base compute, GPU cloud resources for AI workloads and CDN acceleration for global player access. The supporting architecture also included latency testing and path optimization for transcontinental traffic, plus an operating model that can flex server and accelerator capacity up and down as business stages change. In practice, the system lets Kotoko keep service continuity during migration, sustain global interactive performance and avoid overpaying for idle AI infrastructure while the game scales across markets.

solution_components.name: Cloud Servers BCC
solution_components.role: Provide the base compute environment for the game's migrated application services.

solution_components.name: GPU Cloud Servers
solution_components.role: Supply accelerator capacity for the AI-heavy game workloads.

solution_components.name: Content Delivery Network (CDN)
solution_components.role: Accelerates global game access and reduces cross-region latency for players.

data_flow: Game traffic and AI-agent requests are served from BCC and GPU resources, while global player sessions are accelerated through the CDN and optimized network paths to keep response times stable across regions.
business_outcome: Kotoko completed a safer migration path for its global AI game, reduced waste in infrastructure spending and improved stability and access speed for players across regions.
architecture_clues: The architecture spans multiple clouds and regions
GPU and non-GPU resources are scaled independently by business phase
CDN and cross-cloud path optimization are treated as core game requirements
